heroSlides.title: Voron 2.4 vs Trident: Which Should You Build?
heroSlides.excerpt: The two most popular Voron builds share a lot of DNA but differ where it matters. We break down Z systems, build complexity, and which one fits your goals.

heroSlides.title: Phaetus Rapido 2 UHF: The High-Flow Standard
heroSlides.excerpt: The Rapido 2 UHF raises the bar for prosumer hotends. Genuine high-flow performance, broad toolhead compatibility, and a price that makes sense for serious builds.

heroSlides.title: How to Tune Pressure Advance on a Voron
heroSlides.excerpt: Pressure advance is the single biggest print quality lever after basic calibration. Here is how to dial it in correctly on Klipper, Marlin, and RepRapFirmware.

heroSlides.title: PETG: The Default Step Up From PLA
heroSlides.excerpt: PETG closes most of the gap between PLA ease and ABS toughness. Better heat resistance, better layer adhesion — same machines. The tradeoff is stringing and moisture sensitivity.
